body:
We discussed this feature at a recent Core meeting.

Generally, we try to avoid exposing new functions when it is possible to work around an issue in another way. See also [Best practices for engine contributors](https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/engine/guidelines/best_practices.html#the-problem-has-to-be-complex-or-frequent).

That being said, the `reversed()` function better matches our convention of other functions (returning a copy is usually easier to use than in-place modification).

So we'll decide whether to merge this change based on community interest. It would be good if you could create a formal [feature proposal](https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/other/ideas.html) for it. We'll monitor the proposal, and if it becomes clear that this is a frequent problem for users, we'll consider merging the PR.
